text: The skeleton's central part - skull, sternum, ribs and the vertebral column - 80 bones in all.
Peripheral nerve trunks that carry sensory signals inward to the central axis, or motor commands outward to muscles and glands.
Two fusions happen together in the embryo sac: syngamy forms the diploid zygote, while triple fusion yields the primary endosperm nucleus, which is triploid.
A single worldwide measurement standard: the International System of Units, called SI for short, whose base unit of length is the metre.
